# jamfplatform_pro_sso_dependencies (Data Source)

List Jamf Pro objects (typically Enrollment Customizations) currently consuming the tenant's SSO configuration.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Admin identity and access | Single Sign-On | Read | `sso-settings` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_pro_sso_dependencies" "current" {}

output "sso_consumers" {
  value = [
    for dep in data.jamfplatform_pro_sso_dependencies.current.dependencies :
    "${dep.human_readable_name}: ${dep.name} (id=${dep.id})"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `dependencies` (Attributes List) SSO consumers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dependencies))
- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier. Always `singleton`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--dependencies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dependencies`

Read-Only:

- `human_readable_name` (String) Consumer object category (e.g. `Enrollment Customization`).
- `hyperlink` (String) Path to the consumer in the Jamf Pro admin UI.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier extracted from the consumer's UI hyperlink.
- `name` (String) Display name configured on the consumer.
